Package backend

Class World

java.lang.Object
backend.World
public class World extends Object
Represents the shared game world that all sprites and interpreters operate in. Holds the global state of the program including sprites, global variables, keyboard input, and mouse input. Acts as the central source of truth for anything that needs to be shared across sprites.

  • Constructor Details

    • World

      public World()
      Constructs a new World with default state. All sprites start empty, the program starts running, all keys start unpressed, and the mouse starts at (0, 0) and unpressed.

      public boolean isRunning()
      Returns whether the program is currently running. When false, forever loops and other continuous blocks should stop.

      true if the program is running, false if it has been stopped

    • stopProgram

      public void stopProgram()
      Stops the program by setting the running state to false. This causes forever loops to exit on their next iteration check.

    • setGlobalVariable

      public void setGlobalVariable(String name, String value)
      Sets a global variable by name. If the variable already exists it is overwritten. Global variables are shared across all sprites.
      Parameters:

      value - the value to assign, as a String

    • setKeyPressed

      public void setKeyPressed(String key, boolean value)
      Updates the pressed state of a key. Only keys that were registered during initialization (a–z, 0–9) can be tracked. Unknown keys are silently ignored.
      Parameters:
      key - the key to update, case-insensitive (e.g. "a", "1")
      value - true if the key is now pressed, false if released

    • isTouching

      public boolean isTouching(String spriteNameA, String spriteNameB)
      Returns whether two sprites are touching, looked up by their names. If either name does not match a sprite in the world, returns false.
      Parameters:
      spriteNameA - the name of the first sprite
      spriteNameB - the name of the second sprite
      Returns:
      true if the two named sprites are touching, false otherwise

    • isTouching

      public boolean isTouching(Sprite sprite, String otherSpriteName)
      Returns whether the given sprite is touching any sprite with the given name. A sprite is never considered to be touching itself. Useful for clone collision since multiple sprites can share the same name.
      Parameters:
      sprite - the sprite to check
      otherSpriteName - the name of the other sprite(s) to check against
      Returns:
      true if the sprite touches any sprite with the given name, false otherwise

    • getTouchingSprites

      public List<Sprite> getTouchingSprites(Sprite sprite)
      Returns a list of all sprites currently touching the given sprite. The sprite itself is excluded from the results.
      Parameters:
      sprite - the sprite to check collisions for
      Returns:
      a List of Sprite objects that are currently overlapping the given sprite
